description: This file is a shell script containing tests for the behavior of the GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES environment variable, which influences the output of 'git rev-parse --show-prefix'. The script defines test functions, sets various configurations of GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES, and verifies expected behavior, including handling of symlinks and directory boundaries.

methods.name: test_prefix
methods.description: Verifies that 'git rev-parse --show-prefix' outputs the expected prefix when GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES is set.

methods.name: test_fail
methods.description: Checks that 'git rev-parse --show-prefix' fails with the expected error code when GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES is set to a directory outside the current repository.
